title: U.S. lifts chip software curbs on China amid trade truce
text:
The U.S. government has rescinded its export restrictions on chip design software to China, U.S.-based Synopsys announced.
U.S. chip software maker Synopsys said that the U.S. government has rescinded its export restrictions on chip-design software to China.
The U.S. had reportedly told several chip design software companies on May 23 that they were required to obtain licenses."Synopsys is working to restore access to the recently restricted products in China," the California-based software maker said in a "We are in the process of restoring access to our software and technology to affected customers in compliance with US export laws," a Cadence spokesperson said.told several chip design software companies on May 23 that they were required to obtain licenses before exporting goods, such as software and chemicals for semiconductors, to China.Other software providers impacted by the ban include Siemens EDA, a subsidiary of Germany's Siemens.
